scope: Local prepared workflows only; no remote changes

backend.if: ${{ github.event.repository.private == true && github.repository == 'DruHustle/onesa-ai-robot' && github.actor == 'DruHustle' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'DruHustle')) }}

steps.run: python -m ruff check robot_api tests && python -m ruff format --check robot_api tests && python -m mypy robot_api && python -m pytest -q

frontend.if: ${{ github.event.repository.private == true && github.repository == 'DruHustle/onesa-ai-robot' && github.actor == 'DruHustle' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'DruHustle')) }}

steps.run: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm audit --audit-level=high
npx playwright install chromium firefox webkit

steps.name: Synthetic cross-browser operator acceptance
steps.run:
ROBOT_OPERATOR_PASSWORD_HASH=$(cd onesa-ai-robot-backend && python -c "from robot_api.security import password_hash; print(password_hash('browser-test-operator-only'))")
export ROBOT_OPERATOR_PASSWORD_HASH
(cd onesa-ai-robot-backend && sh start.sh) > /tmp/robot-backend-test.log 2>&1 &
backend_pid=$!
(cd onesa-ai-robot-frontend && npm start) > /tmp/robot-frontend-test.log 2>&1 &
frontend_pid=$!
trap 'kill "$backend_pid" "$frontend_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -fsS http://localhost:3431/api/v1/ready > /dev/null; then break; fi
  echo "Waiting for Robot readiness: $attempt"
  sleep 1
done
curl -fsS http://localhost:3431/api/v1/ready > /dev/null
npm --prefix onesa-ai-robot-frontend run test:e2e

containers.if: ${{ github.event.repository.private == true && github.repository == 'DruHustle/onesa-ai-robot' && github.actor == 'DruHustle' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'DruHustle')) }}

steps.run: docker build -t onesa-robot-runtime:${{ matrix.application }}-${{ github.run_id }} ./onesa-ai-robot-${{ matrix.application }}

steps.name: Runtime security gate
steps.run:
mkdir -p data/security
chmod 700 data/security
docker save onesa-robot-runtime:${{ matrix.application }}-${{ github.run_id }} -o data/security/runtime.tar
docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e TRIVY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/trivy-cache -v "$PWD/data/security:/reports" aquasec/trivy:0.75.0@sha256:af6acf9a6b85dfe389a1941505c0ce9efef52a4719635e1a962f022a3d855daa image --scanners vuln,secret --format json --output /reports/runtime.json --input /reports/runtime.tar
python3 scripts/image_gate.py data/security/runtime.json
